messages:
clare: FYI discovered a batch issue: A/B pricing experiment caused partial invoice lines to be omitted for a random subset of US customers. Example: org-id 54321 invoice INV-2026-0911 is missing the 'commitment discount' line (amount should be -1200.00).

jon: omg. is this the same export run that retried earlier?

clare: looks like export job exp:us-20260612-03 retried once. First run used experiment=true, second run used experiment=false. The exporter appended new invoices without voiding the old ones.

phil: blast radius? which customers and totals?

clare: quick scan: 6 accounts, amounts from $45 -> $120k. I flagged INV-2026-0911, INV-2026-0912, INV-2026-0915. Also noticed rounding mismatches between the two runs.

billing-bot: job exp:us-20260612-03 attempts=2 idempotent=false status=completed

jon: mitigation: pause sending for US region, mark all invoices generated between 2026-06-12T03:10 and 03:30 UTC as draft, run reconcile to detect duplicates and pick canonical per finance rule (prefer latest with full lines but allow manual override).

phil: can we auto-void the duplicates for small deltas (<$1) and queue larger ones for manual review?

clare: yes, will include that in the reconcile script. also creating BILL-8005 and attaching CSV of suspect invoices.

jon: long term: exporters must snapshot pricing flags at job start so retries are deterministic. I'll file an RFC and add a test.

clare: action items: jon patch exporter to snapshot flags (ETA 2h), run reconcile and produce corrected drafts (ETA 1h), finance review before sending.

phil: thanks team. please keep updates in BILL-8005.
